title: EVERY WALL In Your Life Will Come Down | Your BREAKTHROUGH is Coming (Christian Motivation)
paragraphs: some of you may be facing enormous challenges right now the walls in your life may seem too high too thick too great to overcome but I want you to know that with God nothing is impossible he specializes in doing what seems unachievable to us scriptures tell us numerous times that nothing is impossible with God in Matthew 19 verse 26 it reads Jesus looked at them and said with man this is impossible but With God all things are possible do you really

believe that if you do then I encourage you to start walking by faith and not by sight your breakthrough is coming and every wall in your life will come down this is not merely a positive statement it's an expression of unwavering faith and the one who has never failed whether it's a wall of fear doubt sickness Financial struggle or any other obstacle that has been holding you back know that it's not there to stay with unwavering Faith continued determination and God's

unfailing support those walls are destined to crumble Embrace The Hope and courage that come with this truth for your breakthrough is on the horizon and every barrier that has been hindering your progress is about to be overcome the victory is yours for God is with you and his power knows no bounds you might be thinking how could I speak with such confidence the answer is simple yet profound my confidence does not stem from my own abilities wisdom or strength it's rooted

in the unshakable faith and trust I have in our heavenly father I've seen him work miracles in my own life and in the lives of countless individuals Breaking Chains tearing down walls and turning situations around in ways that defy human understanding his word is filled with promises and he's a God who keeps every single one of them when we step out in faith believing in his power and his will to act on our behalf we position ourselves to see Divine interventions

and breakthroughs we align ourselves with his purpose and we start to move in the direction of his perfect plan for our lives the same God who parted the Red Sea who brought down the walls of Jericho who turned water into wine is the same God who is with you right now he's not just a god of History he's a god of today right here right now ready to work in your life so let's trust him let's believe in his power his

love his timing let's walk in faith expecting our breakthroughs knowing that he will never fail us our walls will come down because our God is mighty loving and faithful and that is why I can speak with such confidence just believe with me and watch God work in your life every day we encounter walls that stand in our way these walls are the barriers that prevent us from moving forward in life just as the Israelites encountered the daunting walls of Jericho the

story of Jericho is not just a historical Tale it represents the barriers we Face daily just as God commanded the Israelites in Joshua 6 verse 20 to March around Jericho for seven days and the walls fell starting today we are going to do just that we are going to embark on this faith-filled journey so it's important that you watch this video to the very end there are further details and guidance that I'll be sharing and I don't want you to miss

any of it what we are about to do together can change your life and I believe wholeheartedly that God has something special in store for each and every one of you stay with me to the end so you can fully participate in this life-changing experience now we can believe that the walls in our lives will fall through faith and obedience the victory of Jericho teaches us that no wall is too high when God is on our side remember the Israelites did

not conquer Jericho in their strength it was through obedience to God's Specific Instructions we too must heed God's guidance to Break Down The Walls in our lives in Proverbs 3 verse 5 the Bible says trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding trusting in God is the key to tearing down these barriers did you know that God has a history of breaking barriers yes he does God has a history of breaking barriers and his

promises can bring us victory when David faced Goliath he was not relying on his own strength but on God's promises he declared in first Samuel 17 verse 37 the Lord who delivered me from the Paw of the Lion and from the Paw of the bear he will deliver me from the hand of this Philistine David's faith in God's promise brought Victory this powerful statement of faith from David shows that he believed that God would help him just as God had helped

him before some people might hear this and say well that was then but that doesn't mean God will do it again they might think that these Miracles and acts of Deliverance are things of the past in fact I have seen comments of this very nature under some of our videos but let's not listen to those who doubt and try to sow seeds of doubt in your mind for those of us who read the comments I say to you be guided by

Matthew Chapter 13 and be careful of those who choke the word of faith that we bring to you each day let's believe like David did that God is always ready to help us guide us and give us the strength we need God's love and power haven't changed and he's still working in our lives today and the story of Moses parting the Red Sea we see another example of God breaking down physical barriers in Exodus 14 verses 21 to 22 Moses and

the Israelites faced an impassable sea yet by trusting in God they walked through on dry ground God's power knows no bounds and we can trust in his promises these stories remind us that no matter how overwhelming our barriers may seem God can break them we must hold fast to his promises and Hebrews 10 verse 23 reminds us he who promised is faithful by faith in God's word we can see breakthroughs in our lives faith is not merely a belief it's an

act of trust in God that enables us to overcome in The Book of Mark chapter 5 verse 34 the woman with the issue of blood reached out to Jesus in faith and was healed her faith was her healing this is another powerful Testament to What Faith Can achieve understanding Faith requires a Daily Commitment to trust God Abraham is a perfect example he believed God's promise even though the odds were against him his faith was credited to him as righteousness like Abraham

our daily trust in God becomes our strength to tear down the walls in our lives so faith is not a one-time Act but a relationship with God that grows and strengthens us Romans 10 verse 17 tells us so then faith comes by hearing and hearing by the word of God by continually nurturing our faith we equip ourselves to face and overcome any barrier so how do you take action and March towards your walls faith without action is incomplete Joshua and the

Israelites had to March around Jericho acting in obedience to God's command similarly we must take proactive steps Guided by faith and trust in God these actions are not merely physical but spiritual reflecting our obedience and commitment to God's word when Peter walked on water in Matthew 14 29 it was his faith in action the verse says so he said come and when Peter had come down out of the boat he walked on the water to go to Jesus then as soon

as Peter doubted he sang reminding us that our actions must be guided by unwavering faith we must remember as James tells us in James 2 verse 26 that faith without works is dead our faith inspires us to act accordingly and through these faith-driven actions the walls in our lives will come down we must March forward with determination following God's lead now remember Unity is strength fellowship with others play an essential role an overcoming barriers the early Believers in Acts 2 verses

42 to 47 showed us the power of coming together daily praying breaking bread and supporting each other this is just like we do here on our YouTube channel at Daily Jesus devotional this unity in faith amplifies our strength and enables us to break down walls Galatians 6 verse 2 tells us that being united in Christ means bearing each other's burdens when one member struggles the whole body supports and uplifts by leaning on one another and working in unity we become stronger

reflecting Christ's love our fellowship is not merely a social Gathering of a group of subscribers but a spiritual connection helping us face and Conquer our barriers Jesus prayed in John 17 verse 21. that we might be one just as he and the father are one in unity and love we can overcome any obstacle now our breakthroughs are not instant we are not promising something magical here but patience and perseverance are essential in waiting for God's timing the Israelites wandered for 40

years before entering the promised land waiting on God can be hard but his timing is always perfect and this can be a hard lesson because as humans sometimes we want our breakthroughs based on our timing but the reality is this isn't always the case this is where I must remind you to trust God's timing for your life his ways are higher than your ways and his thoughts are higher than your thoughts we must recognize that God's plan is always worth the

wait in the story of Joseph his hardships and trials were part of God's plan to elevate him in Genesis 50 20. we see where God's timing brought about the best outcome and that's what we want too the best outcome so our breakthrough may require patience but God's plan will not fail let us trust God in the process Standing on the Promises found in Isaiah 40 verse 31 but they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength they shall Mount up

with wings as eagles they shall run and not be weary and they shall walk and not faint patience and Trust in God's perfect timing will yield the best results leading to our breakthrough now let's talk about spiritual battles spiritual warfare is a battle we all face we must recognize that not all walls are physical some are spiritual spiritual battles will require spiritual weapons recognizing the nature of our battle enables us to fight effectively Paul reminds us in Ephesians 6. verses 10

to 18. to put on the full armor of God so that we can stand against the devil schemes just like the story of King Jehoshaphat who faced a vast Army we must face our spiritual enemies with praise and faith jehoshaphat's trust in God turned the enemy upon themselves and the battle was won without lifting a sword this can be found in second chronicles 20 verses 22-23 spiritual walls may appear as doubts fears Temptations or other hindrances that hinder our relationship with

God we must remember as the Bible tells us in Ephesians 6 12 we do not wrestle against flesh and blood but against principalities against Powers by putting on the armor of God we can defeat these spiritual barriers the spiritual warfare we face is real but through Christ we have Victory by recognizing and engaging in the right battle wearing the armor of God and standing firm in faith we can overcome any spiritual wall now I want you to know that your breakthrough

is for a purpose our breakthroughs serve a higher purpose they are not mere personal gains but they contribute to God's grand plan Joseph's elevation from the pit to the Palace was not for his benefit alone but the preservation of a Nation your breakthrough may also be a Beacon of Hope for others realizing that our victories serve others encourages us to look Beyond ourselves by embracing our breakthroughs as part of God's Divine Purpose we become instruments in his hands Ephesians 2 verse

10 says for we are his workmanship created in Christ Jesus for good works our lives are interwoven in God's design and our victories have a higher purpose let us embrace our breakthroughs with this perspective knowing that they contribute to God's kingdom and reflect his glory so today I say to you embrace your breakthrough embracing our breakthrough means facing our walls with faith obedience patience and determination these walls will fall just as the walls of Jericho did Hebrews 11 30. confirms by

faith the walls of Jericho fell down after they were encircled for seven days our faith is powerful we are not alone in this journey God's promises our community of Believers and our faith Empower us to overcome let's March forward knowing that through Christ Our Victory is assured John 16 33 tells us in the world you will have tribulation but be of good cheer I have overcome the world let us embrace our breakthroughs as part of God's Grand Design sharing our victories

and supporting one another with joy and confidence we can face any barrier knowing that every wall in our lives will come down now to all those within the sound of my voice let us go to the Lord in prayer I want you to pray this prayer with me so that you can have all the blessings of this prayer let us pray to our gracious and loving God Heavenly Father king of kings and Lord of lords I glorify your name and lift

my voice in praise for your awesome power and eternal Victory Lord you are the one who defeats every enemy and brings down every wall father I honor you for your unshakable Authority and dominion over all things Lord I come before you humbly placing every wall that I face at your feet in the mighty name of Jesus I declare victory over all spiritual warfare that seeks to hinder my progress and keep me from my breakthrough I rebuke every Spirit of confusion and

discouragement that may try to stand against me in the name of Jesus Lord I declare freedom from obstacles disappointments dry spells stagnation and everything that gets in the way of growth and blessings in my life Lord you know every detail every barrier every chain that has been holding me back in the name of Jesus I declare that these obstacles be removed that the dry spells come to an end and that the stagnation will cease I reject every negative word spoken over

my life and I come against anything that is not a view in the name of Jesus I rebuke anything that is keeping me from moving forward and your purpose and plan for my life Mighty God I believe in your power to change my circumstances to bring life where there is barrenness to open doors where there have been walls let your Living Waters Flow in the dry areas of my life and renew me with fresh strength and vitality Lord I come against

any form of delay or resistance that the enemy may be placing in my way I declare victory over it in the name of Jesus I trust that you will guide me past these obstacles and into the fruitful season that you have prepared for me father I ask for your blessings to overflow in my life let your favor surround me and open doors of opportunities that no man can shut I declare in the name of Jesus that blessings and abundance are my

portion Lord I seek your healing touch over every area of my life restore my body mind and soul and make me whole I rebuke every sickness disease and infirmity in my life in the name of Jesus I pray for your protection O Lord build a hedge around me and keep me safe from all harm and Evil I declare in the name of Jesus that no weapon formed against me shall prosper and I will dwell in safety under your wings father I

declare in the name of Jesus that every chain will be broken and every barrier will fall I trust in your promises and I believe that your timing is perfect fill me with unwavering faith and guide me on the path to Victory I thank you in advance for my upcoming breakthrough knowing that with you all things are possible Lord deliver me from every bondage and stronghold that seeks to keep me captive may you free me from every and set me on a

path of freedom and Victory Lord I walk in the Liberty that you provide in the mighty name of Jesus I declare that every wall in my life will come down just like the walls of Jericho Heavenly Father I pray that you will increase my faith that I may believe without wavering in your unchanging love and boundless power help me to see beyond my circumstances and focus on your Eternal truths strengthen my trust in you dear Lord so that I may walk

in confidence knowing that you are in control of every situation and that your timing is perfect Lord I ask that you remove any doubt fear or unbelief from my heart may you replace them with a strong and steadfast faith that can move mountains and Tear Down the Walls that have been holding me back Lord I lift up my loved ones before you and I pray that every wall obstacle or barrier hindering their lives will come down in the mighty name of

Jesus may they experience your breakthrough freedom and the Fulfillment of your promises may they walk in the Abundant Life you have planned for them cover them with your love strengthen them in faith and keep them from harm I declare in the name of Jesus that they will walk in your grace Victory and joy father as I say this prayer together with everyone listening I thank you Lord for every person opening their heart to you right now I pray that you will

Empower each one of us with your Mighty strength Lord may you touch each and every heart with renewed faith and trust in you may we all stand firm in our faith unshaken and Victorious regardless of what we Face knowing that you are with us every step of the way thank you Lord for hearing and answering my prayer I place my trust in you and your Mighty power to break down every wall and overcome every battle in the mighty name of Jesus

I pray amen if you were blessed by this message type the word amen in the comments section below now as we mentioned earlier the story of Jericho represents the barriers we Face daily God commanded the Israelites in Joshua 6 20 to March around Jericho for seven days and the walls fell starting today we are going to do just that but in a somewhat different manner I was moved by the Holy Spirit today to do something different and this is specifically for

the people of Faith Among Us I want to present a unique challenge to each and every one of you here's what I want you to do I challenge you to listen to this sermon and then pray the prayer that we've prayed today for seven consecutive days let's move with faith just as the Israelites did for seven days also write down the names of all the walls in your life the obstacles the barriers everything that has been holding you back then place

that paper in your Bible at Joshua 6 20 and leave it there for these seven days whenever you remember these walls each day instead of worrying or speaking doubt simply thank the Lord for removing those walls do not speak anything contrary to the expected victory your words have power and during these seven days we are going to speak faith Victory and breakthrough this is not just a symbolic Act it's an Act of Faith a profound declaration that just as the walls

of Jericho fell so will the walls in your life come down it's an expectation that what God did then he will do for you now you're aligning yourself with the promise of God and taking a proactive stance in faith it may seem unconventional but remember our God is an unconventional God he works in ways we cannot see and when we align ourselves with his word and his promises we can expect to see Miracles remember every wall in your life is about

to come down not by your power or by your mind but by the spirit of the Lord so let us start this seven day Journey of Faith together note that I am a participant as well we will be expecting that by the end we will see walls crumble and breakthroughs occur let's trust God thank Him in Advance and watch as he works wonders in our lives that only he can do so if you can watch this video and say this prayer

on this channel for the next seven days expect something extraordinary to take place in your life be sure to share your testimonies in the comments for we're expecting that they will be many you can help us to reach more persons and spread the gospel you can do this by sharing the video with a friend or family member who you know needs the blessing of this prayer and by clicking the like button also remember to subscribe to the channel for more videos

that will bless your heart and uplift your spirit we appreciate all your support you're blessed to be a blessing please feel free to leave your prayer requests in the comments section so that we can present them before God for your blessing and Victory and we also invite other believers on the YouTube platform and all over the world to join us and start praying for you right now to God be all the glory I declare that all the blessings of this prayer
are now upon you in the name of Jesus May the grace and peace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all
